units: Keth. 14ᵇ ממזר וצווח חלל ושׁוֹתֵק one who cries (protests) when called a bastard, but keeps his peace when called a ḥalal (v. חָלָל II).
<cite ref="Shabbat 33b:5">Sabb. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>יוסי שש׳ וכ׳</he> Jose, who kept silence (when the Roman government was criticised), shall be exiled to Sepphoris.
<cite ref="Menachot 72a:9">Men. 72ᵃ</cite> <he>הוי פקח ושְׁתוֹק</he> be wise and keep thy peace.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 51:6">Gen. R. s. 51</cite> <he>שתיקה שש׳ לאברהם וכ׳</he> (God remembered to Lot) the silence which he observed towards Abraham when he said &c.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to cause to be silent, silence, stop.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Chagigah 2:12">Tosef. Ḥag. II, 12</cite> <he>שִׁיתְּקוֹ בגערה</he> he silenced him with a rebuke; Y. ib. II, 78ᵃ bot. <he>ושִׁתְּקוֹ בנזיפה</he>.
Sabb. 67ᵇ המְשַׁתֶּקֶת (or המַשְׁתֶּקֶת Hif.), v. צָוַוח; Tosef. ib. VI (VII), 15 השׁוֹתֶקֶת.

Ber. V, 3 האומר … מְשַׁתְּקִין אותו he who (in reading the prayers) says … modim modim (we offer thanks, twice) must be stopped (as suspected of heresy). Tanḥ. Aḥăré 9 בקש יהושע לשַׁתֵּק וכ׳ Joshua wanted to silence the sun (keep him from giving praise, ref. to Josh. X, 12); a. fr.—Esp. to deny the claim of, dismiss.

Yeb. 100ᵇ מאי שתוקי … שמשתקים אותו מנכסי אביו in what respect is he considered a sh’thuḳi (v. שְׁתוּקִי)? Is it that we deny him a share in his father’s estate?; ib. משתקין אותו מדיני כהונה we deny him the privileges of priesthood (declare him a ḥalal); Keth. 13ᵇ מַשְׁתִּיקִין Hif.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 49">Gen. R. s. 49</cite>, end <he>נ׳ הסניגור וכ׳</he> when the defense stops, the judge rises; <he>עמד … נ׳ הסניגור</he> when the judge rises, the defense is bound to stop; Yalk. ib. 84; a. e.
<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 7:1">Gitt. VII, 1</cite> <he>נ׳ ואמרו לו וכ׳</he> if a man has lost his speech, and they say to him, shall we write a letter of divorce &c.? Y. Snh. VI, beg. 23ᵇ; Bab.
